cells.gaps: An August 2026 opinion piece's 9.1 per cent (UGA-005) is unsourced and not the World Bank series. The latest figure, 44.8 per cent of rural people for 2024, is below 53.
cells.note: The World Bank series gives 44.8 per cent of rural people with electricity in 2024, below the 53 per cent line, so stage 2. An August 2026 opinion piece's 9.1 per cent is not from the series and does not set the rung.
